text: Amazon frontier, Novo Progresso (PA) (100.43 ha cell, 100.0 ha of baseline forest) in Representative Amazon frontier cell. Latest clear Sentinel-2 view: 2026-10-09, showing a suspected reversal. Confirmed loss since the baseline: 79.7 ha (79.7% of the cell's forest). The reversal threshold was first crossed on 2024-08-13. 102 clear looks since 2019-06-21 are anchored on-chain. Against the independent Hansen Global Forest Change map (loss 2019-2024), CanopyProof found 92.4% of Hansen's loss pixels, and 66.9% of its own confirmed pixels agree.
disclaimer: Satellite change detection is evidence for review, not proof of carbon loss. It does not assess additionality, baselines or leakage, and a 1 km cell samples a project rather than measuring it.
